input_policy: Question only; no gold, fabricated context or review history in retrieval/model input.

retrieval_scoring.identity: Exact law name and article number including branch number; case identity by court and case number; form identity by regulation and form number.
retrieval_scoring.article_unit: One law/article is one target even when multiple paragraphs are relevant. Paragraph-content sufficiency is a separate check, not another hit.
retrieval_scoring.required_logic: allOf; no OR alternatives are supplied
retrieval_scoring.conditional_and_supporting: Excluded from the fixed base retrieval denominator. Extra generated claims require separate conditional-evidence review.
retrieval_scoring.deduplication: Set union by source identity, never concatenate counts for required and conditional sources.
retrieval_scoring.law_component_complete: All required_statutes retrieved; denominator 30. This alone is not full evidence completeness for the 3 mixed-source items.
retrieval_scoring.full_evidence_complete: All required_statutes AND required_other_sources retrieved; denominator 30. Unavailable document types are missing, not automatic passes or post-hoc exclusions.
retrieval_scoring.unsupported_or_missing: Report corpus/document-type gaps without changing gold to fit the corpus. No performance evaluation has been run.

answer_scoring.status: No automatic semantic grader implemented in this patch.
answer_scoring.rules: Use final answer together with facts_conditions_exceptions, avoid and scoring_impact. review1 is historical, not active gold. A long model answer is not a list of mandatory claims.
answer_scoring.HO-009: Accept a conditional court-order answer with confirmation of registration type as specified in scoring_impact. Do not require the optional Civil Act registration route or A3_4 unless that extra route is asserted. A3_3 is counted once.
answer_scoring.HO-019: Conditional C625 is evaluated only for the additional claim described in conditional.when; it is not required for the base retrieval question.
answer_scoring.boundary: Legal answer quality, citation grounding and abstention are separate from retrieval metrics.

before_first_run: Commit the run protocol before executing questions: code commit, DB/chunk/index/model hashes and revisions, BM25/KURE settings, channel budgets, filtering and actual model-delivery boundary.

Define per-channel Hit@1/3/5 and full-required-evidence metrics, their denominators and handling of channels with fewer returned items. Do not pool separate channel ranks without an explicit protocol.
Archive actual returned IDs and text, and distinguish returned evidence from evidence actually passed to generation.
If generation is evaluated, freeze its prompt/model/settings and claim-level grading procedure before viewing outputs.
Record any changes since the receipt baseline. Do not tune the candidate using these questions before the first measurement.
